path_name: radiation from the jet or flame of a cap-end vent
carrier: the ejecta (gas and flame beyond the end plane)
where_and_reading: near the venting end of the facing half; C1 and the long deliveries
share_of_events: every calorimetry test vented (10 of 10, this cell); fire reported in the rig without a count
note: min(energy 56459.4 J, rate 419.78 W x t); w_sup 0.2500, F_end 0.32234
to_narrow_it: the flame's position and extent beside the cells during venting, its temperature or a radiometer at the facing half's place, and the radiant fraction of such flames

path_name: heat from vented gas that passes the neighbour
where_and_reading: anywhere on the facing half; C2 for the whole half, C1 for the wedges
note: min(energy 225837.8 J, rate 4758.24 W x t); h_max 1143.6 W/(m2 K), F_trig 0.35566
to_narrow_it: the gas's temperature and velocity in the wedges beside the line of contact during venting, or the share of the vent gas that passes

path_name: the jet of a sidewall breach facing the neighbour
where_and_reading: a patch around the point struck; C1
share_of_events: a trigger rupture in 3 of 16 tests in this rig; 0 of 10 in calorimetry; 3 of 3 (35 mm nail) and none (10 mm) in Read et al.; facing the neighbour: 1/6 of the circumference for a narrow jet
note: s_max 1.0000 x E_avail; narrow jets strike for |phi| < 30 degrees
to_narrow_it: where breaches face, how much of the ejecta leaves through them, and the jet's velocity and opening

path_name: solids and melt on or against the facing half
share_of_events: as A1; from a breach, melt falls onto the facing half from 1/2 of the circumference
note: share at most 1 x E_avail; no rate term
to_narrow_it: the mass and temperature of the debris and melt found on the facing half after a test, or a heat-flux gauge there

path_name: conduction through the holder and fixtures
share_of_events: the holder always touches; not determinable
note: not determinable; energy conservation alone caps it at 247333.0 J
to_narrow_it: the inserts' material and contact, or a thermocouple on the holder at the neighbour's ends

path_name: the neighbour's own discharge into the shorted trigger (parallel tests)
where_and_reading: in the roll, by volume; Stage 8 Part B
note: stored energy; at 25 C the rate term V^2/R = 731.2 W gives 15639.4 J within 21.39 s (conditional)
to_narrow_it: the current between the cells in a parallel test, and the neighbour's resistance at its temperature
